text: nearest --against and compare-grams --competitors take by default the first text column that is no url column (steps.texts_column). On a table of parse-html (html, url, text, ..., title, h1) or of url,title,h1,text that is html or title, not text; the user needs --against-column text. A rule that prefers a column named text would fix both steps; it changes compare-grams, so it is outside SEMKIT-038.
